features: 25W boAt Signature Sound: Enjoy bass-heavy boAt Signature Sound from the PartyPal 30 Bluetooth Speaker. The powerful 25W output fills the room with captivating audio for endless fun.
Wired Mic for Karaoke Sessions: Have lively karaoke sessions at parties using the wired mic. Also, you can connect a wired mic for exciting duets.
RGB LEDs: Show off your vibe with the six light effects of this speaker. Stay hooked to the music and set the party mood with the head-turning RGB LEDs.

Up to 6 hours of Playtime: Your weekend binge-watching sessions can continue for up to 6 hours uninterruptedly. Host watch parties for your squad and tune into the new OTT releases with the extensive playtime of this speaker.

Multi-Compatibility: Use Bluetooth v5.3 compatibility or one of the ports, such as USB and AUX, to experience audio delight. Settle into your spot on the couch comfortably and kickstart entertainment the way you want to.
